map.由吸收剂量与品质因数求剂量当量: Find the dose equivalent from absorbed dose and quality factor
map.输入吸收剂量 D 与辐射权重因子 Q，求剂量当量。: Enter the absorbed dose D and the radiation weighting factor Q to get the dose equivalent.
map.📖 查看「由吸收剂量与品质因数求剂量当量 使用指南」: 📖 View Guide: "Find the dose equivalent from absorbed dose and quality factor"
map.H = D·Q；α 粒子 Q=20。: H = D·Q; for alpha particles Q = 20.
map.D × 辐射权重因子 Q 得当量剂量（Sv）。: D times the radiation weighting factor Q gives the equivalent dose (Sv).
map.不同辐射类型危害对比（α 的 Q 高）。: Compare the harm of different radiation types (alpha has a high Q).
map.当量剂量 H = 2 × 20 = 40 Sv；同等 D 用 γ（Q=1）仅 2: Equivalent dose H = 2 x 20 = 40 Sv; the same D with gamma (Q=1) gives only 2 Sv.
map.α 的 Q 可达 20，β/γ 多为 1，同样吸收剂量下 α 危害高 20 倍。: Q reaches 20 for alpha but is mostly 1 for beta and gamma, so at equal absorbed dose alpha is about 20 times more harmful.
map.Sv = Gy × Q；对 γ/β（Q=1）数值相等，α 因高 Q 危害更大。: Sv = Gy x Q; the values are equal for gamma and beta (Q=1), while alpha is far more harmful because of its high Q.
map.由辐射类型与能量决定，α 约 20、β/γ 约 1，具体以防护标准为准。: It depends on the radiation type and energy: about 20 for alpha and about 1 for beta and gamma, with exact values taken from protection standards.
